summary: Validated (A) security hardening + (B) Flippy Deck feature end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 security tests pass, 5/5 Flippy Deck backend tests pass. Frontend: FlippyDeck component renders next to Dice with 250/250 counter, decrements per play, flips animation works, shows DICE and YARDS faces, no console errors. Ownership tokens flow correctly through localStorage → axios interceptor → X-Owner-Token header.

issues: When the current play is a PUNT/FG (no card drawn), the remaining pill snaps back to '250/250' because Game.jsx passes card=null and FlippyDeck falls back to default. Cosmetic — remaining should persist last-drawn value on non-card plays. Not blocking.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) FlippyDeck.jsx: keep displaying the last card's remaining count when the current play has no card (PUNT/FG), instead of falling back to 250/250.
critical_code_review_comments: flippy_deck.py is clean, deterministic composition (150 DICE + 98 YARDS + 2 INJURY = 250) with runtime assert.
sim_engine.py YARDS override correctly clips to goal line on TDs and preserves card_override=true flag.
server.py owner_token stripped on GET /season/{id}; interceptor in api.js correctly forwards X-Owner-Token by body season_id or URL param.
Security headers + rate limits (10/min create, 30/min sim-week, 60/min sim-game) all enforced.
Minor: FlippyDeck.jsx uses `card?.remaining ?? 250` — this default causes visual reset on PUNT/FG plays.

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 tests, next_year_rate_limit skipped to avoid 62s sleep during main run — verified separately in prior smoke tests)

test_credentials: N/A — no auth for this app; ownership uses per-season tokens returned by /api/season/create.
seed_data_creation: Created transient KC 2025 seasons for testing (persisted in MongoDB). No cleanup needed — seasons are per-user and this app has no user accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split into two files: backend_test.py (security regression, 20 tests) and test_flippy_deck.py (Flippy Deck, 5 tests). Sim-game POST needs {season_id, game_id} and returns {game, result:{plays:[...]}}. Plays use key `play_type` (not `type`). Cards attached only to RUN/PASS plays. To test the rate limit test_next_year_rate_limit, use `-k next_year_rate_limit` and expect ~65s runtime. Frontend Flippy tests: seed localStorage['nfl_owner_tokens'] = {sid:token} before navigating to /season/{sid}/game/{gid}.
